title: Texas Standard for Nov. 23, 2026: Texas’ new Democratic land commissioner preps for the role
summary: Texas has a new land commissioner-elect with a remarkable story. Benjamin Flores is a Mexican immigrant, a cybersecurity professional, a pig farmer and a cancer survivor who spent much of...
content: Texas has a new land commissioner-elect with a remarkable story. Benjamin Flores is a Mexican immigrant, a cybersecurity professional, a pig farmer and a cancer survivor who spent much of the final stretch of his campaign in a hospital bed. He also happens to be the first Democrat elected Texas land commissioner in more than 30 years. Source
